schema.name: microdata
schema.description: structured data a page publishes about itself, through schema.org microdata, RDFa or OpenGraph meta tags

props.name: headline
props.description: the title the page declares for itself

props.name: author
props.description: who the page says wrote it

props.name: datePublished
props.description: when the page says it was published

props.name: dateModified
props.description: when the page says it was last changed

props.name: description
props.description: the summary the page declares for itself
examples: The vote clears the way for construction to begin in autumn.

props.name: articleSection
props.description: where the page says it sits in its publication

props.name: publisher
props.description: who the page says published it

props.name: image
props.description: the image the page declares to represent it

props.name: url
props.description: the canonical address the page declares for itself
